theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fcd_cp_smooth_duality
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (w : Euclid P → ℝ) (W : Set (Euclid P)) (V : ℝ), IsOpen W → Bornology.IsBounded W → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) w → (∀ g : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ W → (∀ y, ‖g y‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ y, fderiv ℝ w y (g y) ≤ V) → ∫ y in W, ‖fderiv ℝ w y‖ ≤ V
